items.title: Ukraine scaling RNG export to Europe
items.summary: In Ukraine, Teofipol Energy Company has completed its first gas-to-grid export of domestically produced biomethane (aka renewable natural gas - RNG) to Hungary. In doing so, it has become the fifth Ukrainian biomethane exporter and the fourth company to supply biomethane via the existing gas pipeline infrastructure.

items.title: Wärtsilä to deliver engines for Australia’s largest-ever engine power plant

The 300 MW plant will provide critical grid balancing and system security in Australia.

items.title: Brazil power reforms to boost renewables – GlobalData
items.summary: Brazil is entering a new phase of power sector development as reforms to the electricity market, offshore wind regulation, and low-carbon hydrogen policy support investment in a more diversified renewable energy system.
